Europakonzert 1996: Saint Petersburg
programme.desc: The beautiful Mariinsky Theatre in St. Petersburg formed the background for the 1996 edition of the annual Europe Concert of the Berliner Philharmoniker. In honour of the Russian hosts works by Prokofiev and Rachmaninov. The beautiful Mariinsky Theatre in St. Petersburg formed the background for the 1996 edition of the annual Europakonzert of the Berliner Philharmoniker. In honour of the Russian hosts, the concert opened with highlights from Prokofiev's 'Romeo and Juliet', followed by the Cavatina from Rachmaninoff's opera 'Aleko'. After the intermission, Kolja Blacher featured in the two 'Violin Romances' by Beethoven, followed by a performance of his 'Seventh Symphony'. The orchestra is led by maestro Claudio Abbado.

programme.title: Memory of a Concert
programme.desc: In 2006, Gidon Kremer and Martha Argerich set out on tour performing solos and duets by Bartók and Schumann. The last of the concert series at the Berliner Philharmonie has been recorded for this film, featuring a rare solo performance by Martha Argerich. In 2006, Gidon Kremer and Martha Argerich set out on tour performing solos and duets by Bartók und Schumann. The last of the concert series at the Berliner Philharmonie has been recorded for this film, featuring a rare solo performance by Martha Argerich. A concert film with personal and moving commentary by Gidon Kremer. Program: Schumann's Violin Sonata No. 1, Op. 10, Violin Sonata No. 2, Op. 121; Kinderszenen, Op. 15; Bartók: Violin Sonata No. 1 Sz 75; Violin sonata No. 2 Sz 76.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, ‘Eroica’. This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2014. Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, ‘Eroica’. Composed in 1803 and 1804, this symphony is regarded as a major turning point in Beethoven’s oeuvre as well as Western music history. Symphony No. 3 is longer in duration than any previous symphony. The customary long introduction is replaced by two powerful chords, followed by the introduction of the main theme by the lower strings. The slow second movement is a Funeral March, followed by a quick Scherzo. The fourth and final movement is dominated by a theme from Beethoven’s ballet music for ‘The Creatures of Prometheus’. This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2014.

programme.title: IVC 2019 - Final: Schubert, Wolf et al.
programme.desc: Soprano Erika Baikoff (United States, 1994) and pianist Gary Beecher (Ireland, 1993) perform works by Franz Schubert, Hugo Wolf, Gabriel Fauré, Francis Poulenc, Lili Boulanger, Johanna Bordewijk-Roepman, and Sergei Rachmaninoff, during the final round of the International Vocal Competition 2019 - Lied Duo. This performance was recorded at Theater aan de Parade in ‘s-Hertogenbosch, the Netherlands. Soprano Erika Baikoff (United States, 1994) and pianist Gary Beecher (Ireland, 1993) perform Franz Schubert’s ‘Suleika I, Was bedeutet die Bewegung’, Op. 14, No. 1 (D. 720); Die Blumensprache, Op. 173, No. 5 (D. 519); and, Die Gebüsche, D. 646; ‘Lied vom Winde’ and ‘Der Knabe und das Immlein’ from Hugo Wolf’s Mörike-Lieder; ‘Fleur jetée’ from Gabriel Fauré’s Quatre melodies, Op. 39; ‘C’ from Francis Poulenc’s Deux poèmes de Louis Aragon, FP 122; ‘Les lilas qui avaient fleuri’ from Lili Boulanger’s Clairières dans le ciel; Johanna Bordewijk-Roepman’s ‘Oranje may-lied’; and, ‘Eti letniye nochi’ (These summer nights) from Sergei Rachmaninoff’s Twelve romances, Op. 14, during the final round of the International Vocal Competition 2019 - Lied Duo. This performance was recorded at Theater aan de Parade in ‘s-Hertogenbosch, the Netherlands.

programme.title: Mozart - Gran partita - VII. Finale. Molto Allegro
programme.desc: Les Dissonances play Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Serenade No. 10 for winds in B-flat major, K. 361, also known as the ‘Gran Partita’. The composition is written for twelve winds and double bass and consists of seven parts. This performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris, France, in 2015. Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances play Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Serenade No. 10 for winds in B-flat major, K. 361, also known as the ‘Gran Partita’. The composition is written for twelve winds and double bass and consists of seven parts. The piece’s duration is longer than the composer’s other chamber music works. Remarkably, Mozart chose to use a larger instrumentation. To the eight instruments of the common wind octet, Mozart added two basset horns, two additional horns, and a double bass. This performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris, France, in 2015.

programme.title: Beethoven's Octet and Dvořák's Serenade
programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker is consistently ranked as one of the best orchestras in the world. The Berliner Philharmoniker is an orchestra based in Berlin, Germany and is ranked as one of the best orchestras in the world. In 1990, orchestra members played beautiful chamber music, such as Ludwig van Beethoven's Octet in E-flat major and Antonin Dvořák's Serenade in D minor. Even though both compositions were written for wind instruments, Beethoven reworked and expanded his String Quartet No. 1 for this composition. The performance was recorded at the famous Jaspis-Hall in the New Chambers, besides Sanssouci, the Summer Palace of Friedrich the Great.

programme.title: Stravinsky - Jeu de cartes
programme.desc: Iván Fischer conducts the Budapest Festival Orchestra in a concert recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary in 2015. On the program are Prokofiev's Ouverture on Hebrew Themes, Op. 34 and Violin Concerto No. 2, Op. 63, and Stravinsky's Jeu de Cartes and Firebird Suite No. 2. Iván Fischer conducts the Budapest Festival Orchestra in a concert recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary in 2015. The concert opens with Sergei Prokofiev's Overture on Hebrew Themes, Op. 34. After this, Thomas Zehetmair stars as solo violinist in Prokofiev Violin Concerto No. 2, Op. 63. The second part of the concert is features music by Igor Stravinsky. On the program is music composed for the ballet 'Jeu de cartes' (1937) and the Firebird Suite, No. 2 (1919). 'Jeu de cartes' is one of Stravinsky's neo-classical works and consists of three parts ('deals'). The Firebird Suite, No. 2 is based on the music from the ballet of the same name, which was written for Sergei Diaghilev's Ballets Russes and premiered in Paris in 1910.

programme.title: Jaroussky sings Bach & Telemann
programme.desc: The film Jaroussky sings Bach & Telemann is a portrait of a very special vocalist - and of two exceptional composers: Telemann and Bach. The film Jaroussky sings Bach & Telemann is a portrait of a very special vocalist, and of two exceptional composers. When Philippe Jaroussky - whose angelic voice seems almost timeless, not belonging to any one epoque or decade - sings works by Telemann and Bach, it becomes abundantly clear that the sheer emotional force and the purifying power of their music have not diminished over the centuries. The works performed in this film are Telemann's Jesus liegt in letzten Zügen and Sinfonia from Brockes-Passion; Der am Ölberg zagende Jesus, and Bach's Sinfonia from Ich hatte viel Bekümmernis and Ich habe genug.

programme.title: Music of Naples
programme.desc: Throughout the centuries, the Italian city of Naples has proved to have a remarkably favorable climate for artistic innovation. This documentary explores the various factors of Napolitano everyday life contributing to an extraordinarily diverse musical landscape. Throughout the centuries, the Italian city of Naples has proved to have a remarkably favorable climate for artistic innovation. The presence of the royal or vice royal courts, the practice of music in churches, fraternities, and charitable institutions, financial support from well-to-do citizens, and the popularity of song and dance in public life made for an extraordinarily diverse musical landscape.

In this performance, Les Dissonances play Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Violin Concerto No. 4 in D major, K. 218. Leading violinist Grimal features as the soloist. programme.desc: Every summer, the Greek island of Patmos hosts the Patmos Musical Festival, a unique musical event comprising both a Chamber and a Sacred Music Festival. This documentary captures the 2024 edition, featuring performances by distinguished soloists and ensembles from around the world. Every summer, the Greek island of Patmos hosts the Patmos Musical Festival, a unique musical event comprising both a Chamber and a Sacred Music Festival. This documentary captures the 2024 edition, featuring performances by distinguished soloists and ensembles from around the world. The lineup includes the festival’s artistic director and pianist Roberto Prosseda, Steven Isserlis, Irène Duval, Michael Guttman and the Brussels Chamber Orchestra, and Peter Phillips and The Tallis Scholars. programme.title: Strauss - Piano Quartet in C minor, Op. 13
programme.desc: Violinist Daniel Rowland, violist Rachel Roberts, cellist Julian Arp, and pianist Diana Ketler perform Richard Strauss’s Piano Quartet in C minor, Op. 13, as part of the Stiftfestival 2016 in the Dutch village of Weerselo. This performance was recorded at the Stiftkerk in Weerselo, the Netherlands. Violinist Daniel Rowland, violist Rachel Roberts, cellist Julian Arp, and pianist Diana Ketler perform Richard Strauss’s Piano Quartet in C minor, Op. 13, as part of the Stiftfestival 2016 in the Dutch village of Weerselo. In his early years, Strauss tried to compose different types of chamber music works, including a piano quartet. The young composer started writing the Piano Quartet in C minor in the spring of 1884 and completed it one year later. The work is in four movements and shows considerable influence from Johannes Brahms. It premiered on December 8, 1885 in Weimar and was performed by members of the Halír Quartet with Strauss himself playing the piano part. The following year the work won the first prize given by the Berliner Tonkünstlerverein for a piano quartet. This performance was recorded at the Stiftkerk in Weerselo, the Netherlands.

programme.desc: In the current recital, recorded in 2015 at Teatro alle Vigne in Lodi, Italy, the Italian pianist Roberto Prosseda (*1975) performs a selection of Felix Mendelssohn’s Songs Without Words (Lieder ohne Worte) (Op. 19 No. 1, Op. 38 No. 2, Op. 38 No. 6, Op. 53 No. 2, Op. 30 No. 6, and Op. 62 No. 2), Variations sérieuses, Op. 54, and Fantasie, Op. 28. programme.title: Gennaro Manna - Arias in World Premiere
programme.desc: As the son of one of Naples’ most prominent musical families Gennaro Manna was blessed with a pen both versatile and skilled. And as an icon of the Neapolitan opera seria, with his lively and galant style of music, he trod the path between Baroque and pre-Classical. Abchordis Ensemble performs the world premiere of his finest arias, alternated with instrumental works by Durante, Porpora and Santangelo. programme.title: The LSO performs Dvořák and Tchaikovsky
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a concert performance recorded on March 18, 2021, at St. Luke’s in London. The program features Antonín Dvořák’s Scherzo Capriccioso and selections from Act II of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s The Nutcracker. Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a concert program consisting of Antonín Dvořák’s Scherzo Capriccioso in D-flat major, Op. 66, and selections from Act II of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s famous ballet The Nutcracker (1892). Dvořák’s Scherzo Capriccioso (1883) reflects a period of personal crisis for the composer. The work betrays ever-changing moods and a constant sense of inner restlessness. In the music of The Nutcracker, Tchaikovsky combined memorable melodies with colorful orchestration, which has enchanted listeners for decades. This performance was recorded at LSO St Luke’s in London, UK, on March 18, 2021.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam, the Octopus Symphonic Choir, and four vocal soloists in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 9 in D Minor, Op. 125 at De Doelen, Rotterdam, in 2019. Van Alphen founded Sinfonia Rotterdam in 2000. Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam, the Octopus Symphonic Choir, and four vocal soloists in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 9 in D Minor, Op. 125 at De Doelen, Rotterdam, in 2019. Van Alphen founded Sinfonia Rotterdam in 2000. Under his passionate leadership, this orchestra has developed into one of the Netherland's best-known orchestras. Beethoven’s Symphony No. 9 is widely considered Beethoven’s greatest composition. He completed this symphony in 1824, when he was almost completely deaf. This symphony is unique, since Beethoven included a choir and vocal soloists in the last movement, in which he set parts of Friedrich Schiller's poem Ode an die Freude (Ode to Joy) to music. The symphony consists of four movements: Allegro ma non troppo, un poco maestoso, Molto vivace, Adagio molto e cantabile, and Finale. The four vocal soloists are Gulnara Shafigullina (soprano), Claire Barnett-Jones (mezzosoprano), Matthew Newlin (tenor), and Frederik Bergman (baritone).

programme.title: Europakonzert 2011 - Madrid
programme.desc: This 2011 edition of the celebrated Europakonzert takes place in the beautiful Teatro Real Madrid in Spain. Under the baton of Sir Simon Rattle, the Berliner Philharmoniker welcome famous Flamenco guitarist Cañizares. For the first piece, the orchestra is joined by Cañizares, whose virtuosity and sensitivity are on full display in this multi-faceted and subtle work. For twenty years, the Berlin Philharmonic has celebrated its 1882 founding with a concert at a major European venue, and the 2011 event takes place at the magnificent Teatro Real in Madrid. Under the baton of Sir Simon Rattle, the renowned orchestra performs Joaquín Rodrigo’s beloved Concierto de Aranjuez, Emmanuel Chabrier’s exuberant España, and Sergey Rachmaninov’s dramatic Second Symphony. For the first piece, the orchestra is joined by famous flamenco guitarist Cañizares, whose virtuosity and sensitivity are on full display in this multi-faceted and subtle work. The soloist's virtuosity, his technique, harmony, strength and sensitivity have distinguished Cañizares as a unique artist, considered one of the great flamenco musicians of the turn of the century. Above anything else, however, Cañizares praises simplicity and purity of sound, transmitting a message with a high emotional impact, as is proven in this splendid concert.

programme.title: Dupré - Variations on Two Themes, Op. 35
programme.desc: Italian pianist Alessandro Marangoni and Italian organist Paolo Oreni perform Marcel Dupré’s Variations on Two Themes for piano and organ, Op. 35. Designed by the organist himself, Oreni plays his ‘Wanderer’ organ in this performance, which is currently the largest existing transportable pipe organ. With its 1200 pipes and 42 stops, it has all the essential timbres needed for the organ repertoire. This performance was recorded at FabbricaPoggi in Pavia, Italy, on April 5, 2024.

programme.title: How to get out of the Cage - A year with John Cage
programme.desc: The compelling documentary How to Get Out of the Cage (2012), by award-winning filmmaker Frank Scheffer, presents an intimate portrait of John Cage, one of the 20th century's most important composers. The compelling documentary How to Get Out of the Cage (2012) by award-winning filmmaker Frank Scheffer presents an intimate portrait of John Cage (1912-1992), one of 20th century's most important composers. From 1982 to 1992, Scheffer worked with Cage on numerous occasions, which resulted in unique archives of historical audio-visual material, including interviews, musical performances, and images of locations related to the composer’s life and work. In all Scheffer’s works related to Cage, he used the old Chinese method of chance operations based on the Yi Jing - as often used by Cage himself in his compositions. Instead of using chance operations, Scheffer edited the film in the usual way that is based on choice.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 1 in G minor, Op. 13
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen leads Sinfonia Rotterdam in a performance of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s Symphony No. 1 in G minor, Op. 13, ‘Winter Daydreams’, recorded at De Doelen in Rotterdam, the Netherlands in September 2022. Conrad van Alphen leads Sinfonia Rotterdam in a performance of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s Symphony No. 1 in G minor, Op. 13, ‘Winter Daydreams’, recorded at De Doelen in Rotterdam, the Netherlands in September 2022. Having completed a number of shorter orchestral works, Tchaikovsky embarked on a more ambitious project in March 1866: to write his first symphony. In the summer of that year, the young composer showed his still-unfinished score to his former teachers Anton Rubinstein and Nikolai Zaremba, whose harsh criticism thoroughly disillusioned him. With significant changes, the entire symphony was first performed in 1868, but Tchaikovsky further revised the work in 1874. Not only did the composer subtitle his symphony ‘Winter Daydreams’, he used descriptive titles for the first two of the four movements as well: ‘Dreams of a Winter Journey’ and ‘Land of Desolation, Land of Mists’.

Having completed a number of shorter orchestral works, Tchaikovsky embarked on a more ambitious project in March 1866: to write his first symphony. In the summer of that year, the young composer showed his still-unfinished score to his former teachers Anton Rubinstein and Nikolai Zaremba, whose harsh criticism thoroughly disillusioned him. With significant changes, the entire symphony was first performed in 1868, but Tchaikovsky further revised the work in 1874. Not only did the composer subtitle his symphony ‘Winter Daydreams’, he used descriptive titles for the first two of the four movements as well: ‘Dreams of a Winter Journey’ and ‘Land of Desolation, Land of Mists’.

programme.title: Ice Dance: Sleeping Beauty (2013)
programme.desc: Set to the magnificent compositions of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky, The Sleeping Beauty retells the classic fairy tale love story through sublime world class ice dancing, breathtaking high speed lifts and throws, awe-inspiring aerial gymnastics and fire effects in a choreography by the award-winning Tony Mercer, all in the enchanting setting of a theater stage. Performed by a cast of world class ice skaters, holding more than 300 competition medals between them, this wintery spin on one of the most famous fairy tales of all time enchants with creative and powerful story-telling, sumptuous sets, spectacular special effects and opulent costumes. Recorded 2013 at the Teatro Montecasino in Johannesburg, South Africa.

programme.title: Mussorgsky - Pictures at an Exhibition
programme.desc: Conductor Mariss Jansons conducts the Bavarian Radio Symphony Orchestra in a rendition of Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition. Recorded at Herkulessaal, Munich in 2014. Conductor Mariss Jansons, the Bavarian Radio Symphony Orchestra and Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition were predestined to come together. The lavish colors of Ravel's orchestration of the Russian work, the breathtaking inventiveness of the wildly different movements that are all interconnected through a recurring Promenade - few conductors are as adept as Jansons to savor all the richness and colorfulness of the paintings and sketches by Victor Hartmann. Today, the work is universally celebrated in its dazzling orchestral transcription by Maurice Ravel. It was the great conductor Serge Koussevitzky who commissioned the orchestration by Ravel in 1922. Recorded at Herkulessaal, Munich in 2014.

programme.title: Brahms - Violin Sonata No. 1, Op. 78
programme.desc: In this splendid 2013 concert from the Church of Verbier, Switzerland, Greek violinist Leonidas Kavakos and Chinese pianist Yuja Wang join forces to interpret three sonatas of Johannes Brahms. In this splendid 2013 concert from the Church of Verbier, Switzerland, Greek violinist Leonidas Kavakos and Chinese pianist Yuja Wang join forces to interpret three sonatas by Johannes Brahms. Leonidas Kavakos rose to fame in 1985, when he became the youngest musician to ever win the first price of the prestigious Sibelius Competition. With Yuja Wang, an accomplished artist at young age herself, he forms a masterful duo of chamber music interpretation. The programme features Brahm's Sonata for Piano and Violin, No. 1 in G major, Op. 78, also known as the "Regensonate," Sonata for Piano and Violin, No. 2 in A major, Op. 100, the "Thuner Sonata," a portrait of the Swiss lake of Thun's peaceful scenery. It comes to a fiery and passionate finale with Brahm's Sonata for Piano and Violin, No. 3 in D minor, Op 108.

programme.title: Vocal works by Puccini, Leoncavallo a. o.
programme.desc: The six-concert series Io suono italiano is dedicated to music of Italian composers and performed by Italian musicians on Italian instruments. These performances were filmed at the atmospheric Teatro Sociale in Rovigo, Italy, in January 2021. In this program, Maria Luigia Borsi (soprano) and Antonio Artese (piano) perform songs and arias by Francesco Paolo Tosti, Giacomo Puccini, Renato Brogi, Ruggero Leoncavallo, and Alfredo Catalini. The six-concert series Io suono italiano is dedicated to music of Italian composers and performed by Italian musicians on Italian instruments. The concert programs cover four centuries of music: from Girolamo Frescobaldi and Antonio Vivaldi to more contemporary music by Ennio Morricone and Azio Corghi. Each program presents more familiar pieces alongside lesser-known compositions. These performances were filmed at the atmospheric Teatro Sociale in Rovigo, Italy, in January 2021. In this program, Maria Luigia Borsi (soprano) and Antonio Artese (piano) present a recital consisting of several songs and arias. On the program are Francesco Paolo Tosti’s Sogno, ‘A vucchella, and L’alba separa dalla luce l’ombra; Giacomo Puccini’s Sole e amore, Sogno d’or, Donde lieta (from La Bohème), Il bel sogno di Doretta (from La rondine), and O mio babbino caro (from Gianni Schicchi); Renato Brogi’s Presentimento, Ruggero Leoncavallo’s Mattinata, and Alfredo Catalini’s Chanson Groenlandaise.

programme.title: Donizetti - Lucia di Lammermoor
programme.desc: Italian conductor Speranza Scappucci leads the Philharmonia Zürich and Chorus of the Opernhaus Zürich in a performance of Gaetano Donizetti’s tragic opera ‘Lucia di Lammermoor’ (1835). Among the soloists are Irina Lungu (Lucia), Massimo Cavalletti (Enrico Ashton), Piotr Beczała (Edgardo di Ravenswood), Andrew Owens (Lord Arturo Bucklaw), Oleg Tsibulko (Raimondo Bidebent), Roswitha Christina Müller (Alisa), and Iain Milne (Normanno). This performance was recorded at the Opernhaus Zürich, Switzerland, in 2021.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Zexal
programme.desc: Kada ambiciozni duelist Yuma upozna Astral, tajanstvenog posjetitelja iz drugog svemira, čini se kao sudbina. Yuma treba Astrala da ga nauči kako da se dvoboji, a Astral treba Yumu da mu pomogne povratiti sjećanja! Oni bi bili najveći tag tim dvoboja... osim što se ne slažu! Ovaj duel bolje da se brzo spoji jer ZEXAL je potpuno novi dvoboj s većim izazovima nego ikad prije! Fantastična nova čudovišta! Snažne nove karte! Tehnologija dvoboja s proširenom stvarnošću! Zajedno, dvoboj ide na sljedeću razinu! Ali ne brinite ako nikada prije niste bili u dvoboju: Dok Astral prolazi Yumom kroz osnove, novi gledatelji mogu pratiti i naučiti kako se natjecati. A za iskusne profesionalce, postoji mnogo nikad viđenih strategija koje se mogu koristiti u stvarnom životu! Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL - Nova pravila, novi dvoboji!

programme.desc: Kada ambiciozni duelist Yuma upozna Astral, tajanstvenog posjetitelja iz drugog svemira, čini se kao sudbina. Ovaj duel bolje da se brzo spoji jer ZEXAL je potpuno novi dvoboj s većim izazovima nego ikad prije! Fantastična nova čudovišta! Snažne nove karte! Tehnologija dvoboja s proširenom stvarnošću! Zajedno, dvoboj ide na sljedeću razinu! Ali ne brinite ako nikada prije niste bili u dvoboju: Dok Astral prolazi Yumom kroz osnove, novi gledatelji mogu pratiti i naučiti kako se natjecati. A za iskusne profesionalce, postoji mnogo nikad viđenih strategija koje se mogu koristiti u stvarnom životu! Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL - Nova pravila, novi dvoboji!

programme.title: Novo jutro
programme.desc: Milionski auditorijum sa teritorije cele Srbije, svih starosnih i socijalnih kategorija svoj dan počinje uz "Novo jutro". Pored najpopularnijih voditeljskih tandema, gledaoci tokom cele radnje nedelje ostaju uz naše jutro zahvaljujući pravovremenom i aktuelnom izveštavanju kroz neizostavne rubrike: "Prelistavanje dnevne štampe", "Tema jutra", "(Ne)zapaženo" i mnoge druge. Zaštitni znak "Novog jutra" su i uključenja iz cele Srbije, ali i Beograda zahvaljujući autentičnom Filipu Maksimoviću i uvek nasmejanom Milanu Raoniću, uz koje ćemo i ovu sezonu početi u vrhu top liste gledanosti.

programme.title: Premijera

programme.title: Oteta, serija
programme.desc: Priča o Orhunu, koji želi da osveti svoju sestru, i Hiri, koja je zarobljenica svoje savesti... Orhun je uspešan biznismen koji je odrastao u bogatoj porodici bez ljubavi zajedno sa svojom sestrom bliznakinjom Nihan, mlađom sestrom Nursah i njihovom hladnom, udaljenom majkom Afife. Nihan je otišla da volonterski radi kao lekar u Eritreji, ali je odnedavno bilo nemoguće kontaktirati, a njena porodica je zabrinuta za nju. Dok traži svoju sestru, nailazi na Hiru, siromašnu devojku koja živi kao zatvorenik u rukama trgovaca ljudima. Kada saznaju da je Nihan otrovala i ubila lokalna banda, Orhun se slomi. Kada se ispostavi da je Hira zapravo bila ta koja je otrovala njegovu sestru, Orhun kuje zli plan osvete: povest će Hiru kući sa sobom i učiniti joj još gore. U međuvremenu, Afife, njihova majka, tajno je držala Orhunovog oca podalje od njegovog detinjstva. Orhun odlučuje da se oženi Hirom iz osvete. Afife mrzi ljude nižeg statusa i opsednuta je "čistom krvlju". Hoće li ovaj brak zatvoriti Afife, ili će par pronaći iskupljenje nakon što plati sve svoje obaveze?

programme.title: Klopka ljubavi, serija
programme.desc: Mračna kletva „visi nad bogatom porodicom Develioglu. Njen naslednik mora da je dečak, ali za Džihana, naslednik porodične imperije, deca su samo neostvarena želja. On u ljubav ne veruje. Sklopio je brak po dogovoru i smatra da je prosto nemoguće biti uspešan i u poslovanju i u ljubavi. Ljubav je za njega slabost. Njegova majka Mukader, nemilosrdni čuvar porodične tradicije i budućnosti, spremna je na sve da obezbedi svom sinu naslednika. Ona nudi Bejzi, Džihanovoj neplodnoj ženi, opasan dogovor: razvod za Džihanino potomstvo, uz obećanje da će se vratiti nakon rođenja njegovog sina. Inače Bejza je takođe iz imućne turske porodice.Sa druge strane, u siromašnoj četvrti Istanbula, živi mlada Hančer koja se bori sa životom u siromaštvu. Živi sa bolesnim bratom, njegovom ženom i bratancem. Hančer dobija ponudu koja će promeniti njenu sudbinu: brak sa Džihanom. Naravno uslov je da je plodna i poslušna, kao i da pristane na brak bez emocija. Iako njeno srce traži pravu ljubav, bolesni brat je tera na žrtvu.Džihan i Hančer nisu ni svesni da prave nepovratni korak. Život će im se ispuniti intrigama i tajnama, ništa više neće biti isto. Džihanova bivša žena Bejza neće nestati iz njihovih života. Oštra i moćna Mukader će uraditi sve da brak bude samo dogovor i da se posle rođenja naslednika reši Hančer. Hančer samo sanja da pomogne svojoj nesrećnoj porodici, dok Džihan traži ženu isključivo zbog naslednika.Hoće li ljubav ipak pronaći put u svetu gde svako teži želji za bolje?

programme.title: Odbačena, serija
programme.desc: Reč je o životnoj avanturi devojčice po imenu Melisa Celik, koja je kao beba ostala bez roditelja, a koja je ostala u sirotištu. Niko ne zna istinu o tome šta se desilo njenoj porodici. Melisa pokušava da ostane sa porodicom koja ju je usvojila, ali Besime, domaćica, ne želi Melisu i podvrgava je raznim mučenjima. Jednog dana, kada je kao žrtvu gneva stave na vrata, pred njom se pojavljuje muškarac, Metin. Tada počinju da pričaju, nesvesni da će im se život od tog trenutka potpuno promeniti.

programme.title: Sudbina, serija
programme.desc: Zejnep je oličenje gracioznosti i inteligencije, kojoj se svi dive. Ipak, ona ima skriveni ratnički duh. Halil, mlad bez roditelja i opterećen tugom, suočio se sa životnim nedaćama. Njihovi putevi se prepliću - Zejnep, slobodnog duha ispod svoje staložene spoljašnjosti, i Halil, odan porodici. Zajedno u vrtlogu ljubavi, oni nalaze da su njihove sudbine neraskidivo povezane. Dok se kreću putem prepunom izbora i posledica, ostaje pitanje: može li njihova ljubav izdržati izazove sa kojima se suočavaju?

programme.title: Ljubav i mržnja, serija
programme.desc: Serija prati zgode i nezgode bogate beogradske porodice Lazarević. Niko nije preboleo smrt majke, koja je bila stub porodice. Bogdanova nova supruga Kaća je moralno nepodobna. Temperamentna je i često stvara probleme unutar porodice. Takođe krije tajne iz prošlosti, koje je proganjaju. U biti je nesigurna ličnost i stidi se svojih seljačkih korena. Bogdanov sin Bojan je ženskaroš i ima aferu sa svojom maćehom Kaćom. To mu stvara niz neprilika, jer joj je obećao da će se razvesti od supruge i osnovati nov život sa njom. Međutim, Bojan ima niz ljubavnih veza. Njegova žena Ljubica je plemenita i odana osoba. Uspešna poslovna žena. Bojanov brat Miloš je novinar, nezadovoljan je, jer je zapravo želeo da bude pisac. Zbog toga često posegne za alkoholom. Njegova supruga Ivana očajnički želi da zatrudni, ali joj to ne uspeva. Njen otac Dušan je bivši narkoman i pravi joj dodatne probleme. Novinarka Zdenka je Miloševa koleginica iz lista "Jutarnja Zvezda", kojoj je porodica Lazarević omiljena tema. Bojanova i Miloševa sestra Olja je najmlađi član porodice i ona najviše pati zbog majčine smrti. Olja neočekivano zatrudni, otac deteta je njen profesor Vojin sa fakulteta. Nije sigurna šta da učini.

programme.title: Trenutak iz sna
programme.desc: "Trenutak iz sna" donosi nam snažne priče o ljudima koji su koračali trnovitom stazom života. Njih sudbina nije štedela, što se odrazilo na njihovo zdravstveno stanje i fizički izgled. Sada im se pruža jedinstvena prilika da putem učešća u emisiji "Trenutak iz sna" promene svoj život. Vrhunski stručnjaci u oblasti hirurgije, stomatologije i kozmetologije pomoći će u ostvarivanju njihovih želja, menjajući ne samo njihov izgled već i psihičko stanje i zdravlje.

programme.title: SCENA
programme.desc: Emisija se bavi aktuelnim dešavanjima iz života poznatih, prati bitne događaje na domaćoj javnoj sceni i donosi pregršt zanimljivih vijesti, intervjua i izveštaja o poznatima. Za ovu zabavnu emisiju o poznatima govorile su najveće domaće i regionalne zvijezde, a čine je i aktuealne vijesti iz svijeta šoubiznisa, kako domaćeg, tako i stranog. Ekipa emisije SCENA REGION donosi sve važne vijesti iz života poznatih i prati sve najznačajnije događaje, ne samo u zemlji, već i u regionu.

programme.title: Kuća od srca
programme.desc: Pomoći najvećem broju ugroženih porodica u kratkom roku - to je cilj ekipe serijala Kuća od srca. Razloga zbog koga je ova emisija najhumaniji TV serijal na ovim prostorima je mnogo - na prvom mestu, ekipa na čelu sa Žarkom Lazićem uspela je da zbrine više od 30 višečlanih porodica koje su živele na rubu egzistencije, bez krova nad glavom. Za Žarka ne postoji nemoguće: kroz dosadašnje sezone uspeo je da prevaziđe sve prepreke, čak i onda kada je to izgledalo nemoguće. Kako je TV Pink uvek imala sluha za potrebe najugroženijih, ova humana misija nastavlja se u osmoj sezoni serijala Kuća od srca.

programme.title: DNK
programme.desc: Potraga za neobičnim životnim pričama širom Srbije nastavlja se u emisiji DNK. Natalija Simović pokušaće da uz pomoć rezultata DNK analize unese mir u domove učesnika koji sumnjaju u očinstvo, a rasplet situacija često je turbulentan i dramatičan, a ponekad i komičan. Zbog toga je emisija „DNK već čitavu deceniju u samom vrhu gledanosti.

programme.title: Premijer, serija
programme.desc: PREMIJER je sitkom serija na temu lica i naličja politike i političara. Junaci PREMIJERA iza visokih državnih funkcija kriju ljudske mane i vrline i mi pokušavamo u neskrivenom nušićevskom maniru, da iznesemo pred gledoce smešnu a ponekad i gorku stranu ličnosti onih koji odlučuju o sudbini naroda i zemlje. Naravno, PREMIJER se ne bavi aktuelnim i stvarnim političarima, to bi bila puka estradna imitacija, a i realni političari su se pobrinuli da uđu u naše živote svojom neponovljivošću i originalnošću. Pričati priče o njima bilo bi lažiranje stvarnosti. Naš Premijer igraće se politikom u (ne)dalekoj budućnosti, 2015. godine, kada će mnogo toga biti drugačije u našoj zemlji, osim mentaliteta, sujete, ambicija, podmetanja, borbe za vlast i drugih sitnica koje su, zapravo, krupne teme ove serije. PREMIJER će, pored visoke politike, kao kontrapunkt, sagledavati i privatnost i porodični život političara, domaćih i stranih i dokazati da su, uprkos svemu i oni ipak samo ljudi. Oni iz 2015. godine, razume se.

programme.title: Novo jutro
programme.desc: Milionski auditorijum sa teritorije cele Srbije, svih starosnih i socijalnih kategorija svoj dan počinje uz "Novo jutro". Pored najpopularnijih voditeljskih tandema, gledaoci tokom cele radnje nedelje ostaju uz naše jutro zahvaljujući pravovremenom i aktuelnom izveštavanju kroz neizostavne rubrike: "Prelistavanje dnevne štampe", "Tema jutra", "(Ne)zapaženo" i mnoge druge. programme.title: Novo jutro
programme.desc: Milionski auditorijum navikao je da dan započinje upravo jutarnjim programom TV Pink. Svakog dana građani Srbije dobijaju sve pravovremene i objektivne informacije. Osim najaktuelnijih vesti iz zemlje i sveta, u jutarnjem programu "Novo jutro" gledaoce očekuju dobro poznate rubrike - "Saveti lekara", "Prelistavanje dnevne štampe", "Tema jutra", "Saveti advokata" i "Razgibavanje". Jutarnji program osvežen je i novim rubrikama - "(Ne)zapaženo" koja se bavi društvenim temama o kojima se priča ili pak onima koje zavređuju više naše pažnje. Rubrika "Pod reflektorima" posvećena je glumcima a "Hit jutra", gostovanju pevača najnovijih izdanja. "Novo jutro" donosi i uključenja iz gradova širom Srbije - Niša, Novog Sada, Kraljeva, Čačka, Zaječara, Valjeva i naravno Beograda - kroz koja će gledaoci dobiti sve važne servisne informacije za ostatak dana. Novitet u jutarnjem programu "Novo jutro" je i lutajući reporter, Filip Maksimović, kog je publika već imala priliku da upozna kroz vrlo karakteristična uključenja sa terena.

programme.title: Mješoviti brak, serija
programme.desc: Serija "M(j)ešoviti brak" snimljena je na osnovu istoimene pozorišne predstave koja spada među najgledanije poslednjih godina. Naravno, dodati su novi likovi, proširena je priča, a gastarbajterska porodica Čađenovic vratila se u novu državu, Srbiju i Crnu Goru. Čuli su za promene, pa su odlučili da posle više godina boravka u Lucernu, u Švajcarskoj, teško zarađene devize ulože u biznis u Beogradu. Sasvim slučajno, prvi kadrovi ove serije snimljeni su u državi koja se zvala Jugoslavija, a prva epizoda završena je u državi, koja se poput ovog mešovitog braka Crnogorca i Srpkinje, zove Srbija i Crna Gora.

programme.title: Preživeti Beograd, serija
programme.desc: Preživeti Beograd je priča o mladim ljudima koji dolaze u Beograd da studiraju, njihovim željama, ljubavima, kao i ambicijama da uspeju u životu. Paralelno tu je i priča o njihovim roditeljima koji dolaze iz različitih socijalnih miljea. Zastupljeni su njihovi kontrasti, dolazak ljudi iz malih sredina u velikigrad. Preživeti Beograd je iskrena, dinamična serija koja se bavi optimizmom, ambicijama i emocijama, i samim tim mlađoj generaciji, ali i njihovim roditeljima nudi dobar sadržaj.

programme.title: Crveni mesec, serija
programme.desc: Ljubavna, ali i snažna istorijska priča, smeštena je u period od avgusta 1913, nakon pobede Srbije u Balkanskim ratovima kada je povratila deo teoritorije, do kraja 1915. godine, kada je austrougarska vojska okupirala Beograd. Glavni junak, mladi srpski oficir koga tumači Miloš Đurović, vraća se sa ratišta u rodnu kuću. Svadba mu je, tradicionalno, već zakazana, ali zaplet priče počinje kada se ćerka austrougarskog poslanika, koju igra Ivana Dudić, zainteresuje za njega. Nedopustivo za to vreme, koketna mlada dama, ne krije svoja osećanja prema mladom oficiru. Rasplet njihove ljubavne drame,koja je plod mašte autora, odvija se u realnom istorijskom periodu pred Veliki rat, pa se u scenariju pojavljuje još dvadesetak glavnih likova, uglavnom stvarnih istorijskih ličnosti. Ovo ostvarenje obiluje dramatičnim događajima, špijunskim intrigama, diplomatskim nadmudrivanjima, političkim spletkama i prevarama...

programme.desc: Tijekom jedne noći 2001. godine, skupina mladih ljudi kreće u provod u Beogradu. Drugi (Nebojša Glogovac) pak, odlučuje u ime skupine da uljepša večer s nešto bijelog praha. Primopredaja je zakazana u bivšem turskom kupatilu, a sada javnom WC-u čije su prostorije, po svoj prilici, uklete od slučaja čedomorstva nekoliko desetljeća ranije. Tamo ih čeka niz nimalo simpatičnih likova, uključujući i masovnog ubojicu.

programme.title: Za sreću je potrebno troje, film
programme.desc: Nismo ni svjesni na što nas sve može natjerati teška životna situacija, a nakon kriza i patnji najteže je pronaći izlaz, svjetlo na kraju tunela. Siromaštvo i očaj natjerali su čovjeka da dječjim plastičnim pištoljem opljačka dućan u provincijskom gradu. Nakon tri godine provedene u zatvoru, on izlazi na slobodu. Prolazeći kroz Zagreb sreće dvije potpuno različite žene koje će odrediti njegovu sudbinu. Priča je to o grčevitim pokušajima i nadi da se pomoću ljubavi može pobjeći iz tužne realnosti vlastitog života i vremena u kojem se taj život odvija. Sjajan redatelj Rajko Grlić ("Novo, novo vrijeme", "Josephine","Pitka voda i sloboda III) koji je 1986. za ovaj film dobio i formalno priznanje u vidu Zlatne palme, kao i fantastični glumci: Miki Manojlović ("Ze film", "Mi nismo anđeli 2", "100 minuta slave"), Mira Furlan ("Diši duboko", Babylon 5: Thirdspace", Babylon 5: In the Begining") i Bogdan Diklić ("Vojnikova ljubav", "Nacionalna klasa") potrudili su se da ovaj jugoslavenski film i nakon dvadeset godina oduševljava gledatelje pred malim ekranima.

programme.title: Buđenje pacova, film
programme.desc: Neuspjeli pokušaj jednog usamljenika da izmjeni svoj sivi i besmisleni život. Tragajući za poslom i novcem, zaljubljuje se u nepoznatu djevojku za koju vjeruje da predstavlja prekretnicu u njegovom dotadašnjem življenju. I baš kada njegova iluzija o sreći dostigne vrhunac, nepoznata krišom odlazi sa njegovim, od poznanika dobijenim novcem, ostavljajući ga razočaranog i prevarenog tamo gdje je bio prije ovog susreta.

programme.title: Jagode u grlu, film
programme.desc: Filmska priča ponovno okuplja stare školske prijatelje koji su sada, nakon 15 godina, situirani i odrasli ljudi, no ne nužno ozbiljni i savjesni. Stari se prijatelji nalaze povodom dolaska Mikija Rubiroze iz inozemstva. Bane Bumbar i njegova žena Biljka, Goca, Uške, Boca Čombe i Miki nalaze se na splavi zakupljenoj samo za njih. Uz sjećanje na mladost u vrijeme šezdesetih, prijatelji piju i jedu te sentimentalan sastanak i nostalgična sjećanja prerastu u turbulentnu noć svađa, rastava, mirenja, zamjeranja, igranja skrivača, a sve uz prateći band koji izvodi evergreene poput O sole mio, El condor pasa, O, mladosti (Arsen Dedić), Love Me Tender... Jagode u grlu (1985) svojevrstan je nastavak iznimno popularne serije iz 70-tih Grlom u jagode, koja je oduševljavala svojom duhovitošću, neposrednošću, sarkazmom te opisala lude 60-te na balkanskim prostorima. Tvorci su filma, kao i serije, eminentni filmaši: Srđan Karanović i Rajko Grlić. Režiju potpisuje Srđan Karanović, (Miris poljskog cveća, Petrijin venac) koji također s Rajkom Grlićem (Samo jednom se ljubi, U raljama života) supotpisuje i scenarij. U glavnim su ulogama poznati srpski glumci.

programme.title: Sveti Georgije ubiva Aždahu, film
programme.desc: Godina: 1914. Mjesto: selo u Srbiji na obali rijeke Save, prirodne granice sa moćnim Austrougarskim carstvom. Stanovništvo u selu je podijeljeno između dvije radikalno suprotstavljene struje - na jednoj strani su tjelesno sposobni seljani, potencijalni vojni regruti, na drugoj invalidi veterani iz prethodna dva balkanska rata. Između te dvije grupe vlada veliki animozitet. Ubrzo počinje Prvi svjetski rat i zdravi dio populacije je mobiliziran. Invalidi koji su ostali u selu pokušavaju iskoristiti žene i sestre vojnika. Ove vijesti dopiru do srpskih vojnika u rovovima par dana prije očekivanog neprijateljskog napada. Da bi spriječila pobunu, srpska Komanda odlučuje poslati invalide na frontu i tako riješi "neprijatnost". Ovi neobični događaji, zasnovani na istinitoj priči, su pozadina za nesretni ljubavni trokut između mladog ratnog invalida, lokalnog policajca i njegove žene, koji se okončava kao u staroj grčkoj tragediji.

programme.title: Piknik u Topoli, film
programme.desc: Kraka je opet pobjegao od kuće. S Maksom luta gradom cijelu noć. U dragstoru sreću studenticu Olgu i Kraka joj u šali ponudi brak. Nekoliko dana kasnije njih dvoje se zaista vjenčaju. Nekolicina mladih odlazi na obližnji kanal da nekonvencionalno proslave vjenčanje, no pojavljuju se i dva pripita vršnjaka iz obližnjeg gradića koje pozovu da im se pridruže. Mladići odbijaju, a Aleksova djevojka shvaća da je namjeravaju silovati. Nastane tučnjava u kojoj mladoženja i njegovi prijatelji moraju spašavati živu glavu.

programme.title: Idemo dalje, film
programme.desc: U tek oslobođeni gradić u Srbiji dolazi mladi učitelj, partizan. Njegova ratna, partizanska "pedagogija" sudara se sa starim metodama rada u školi. Djeca su, naravno, uvijek uz svog učitelja, iskrenog druga. Priča je, u stvari, dječje sjećanje i pamćenje jednog vremena koje je ostavilo duboke tragove u ranjivim mladim dušama čitavih generacija.

Maceo Parker: Jazz à Juan, Jazz
programme.desc: As a 25-year-old saxophonist, Maceo Parker played in the band of James Brown, but he is also known for his collaborations with George Clinton's Parliament-Funkadelic and Bootsy Collins' Rubber Band. Maceo has proven his star quality by creating a special chemistry between all the different styles of American black music. As a pioneer in the ‘groove’, he blends funky jazz with roots and blues with gospel. The result? Overheated concert halls, with enthusiastic audiences that completely surrender themselves to the music's boundless energy.

programme.title: Aki Rissanen Trio at Jazzclub Unterfahrt, Munich, Modern
programme.desc: Aki Rissanen's interest in jazz came after he started taking classical piano lessons. His deep interest in improvised music placed him among top jazz pianist in his home country - Finland. While composing and performing his own music, Rissanen has also collaborated with Verneri Pohjola and Dave Liebman, and today his name appears among the top European jazz musicians. Live from 'Jazzclub Unterfahrt' in Munich, Germany, together with Antti Lotjonen on bass and Teppo Makynen on drums, Rissanen showcases the best of Scandinavian jazz and its DNA - the Nordic Tone.

programme.title: Winter 1980: Maynard Ferguson Big Band in Brussels, Modern
programme.desc: The Brussels Jazz Club was filled to the brim with both musicians and audience members when the Maynard Ferguson Big Band performed there during their Winter Tour of 1980. From the first notes of the cover of Weather Report’s Birdland that opens the performance to the final notes of Gonna Fly Now that closes it, Ferguson gives his young sidemen ample time to shine. The mutual admiration shared by the leader and his sidemen makes this performance a delight to watch.

programme.title: El Guïje, Concert
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2’ to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Batá’. The batá repertoire - the deep classical music of West Africa - permeates Valdés’ piano solos throughout the concert. Valdés’s band consists of Dreiser Durruthy (Batas and vocals), Yaroldy Abreu (percussions and vocals), Abraham Mansfarroll (percussion), Ramón Vazquez Martirena-Bajo (bass guitar). They delivered a performance that reverberated through the historic island.

programme.title: Georgie Fame & the Blue Flames, Modern
programme.desc: Georgie Fame, known for "Yeh, Yeh" and "The Ballad of Bonnie and Clyde" makes a triumphant comeback with The Blue Flames. Georgie Fame and the Blue Flames was a popular band in the UK in the '60s, celebrated for its R&B, soul, jazz, ska, and pop sounds. The training was largely inspired by ska, a popular musical style in Jamaican cafes in London at the time. It was the song "Green Onions" from the Booker T & The MG that inspired Georgie to incorporate the Hammond organ into her compositions. This performance by Georgie Fame and the Blue Flames is brimming with blues and soulful sounds that will delight the group's old and new fans.

programme.title: Chamber music: Sissoko & Segal, World
programme.desc: Hailing from a long tradition of Malian kora players, Ballake Sissoko has worked with renowned musicians such as Toumani Diabaté and Taj Mahal. He met the French born Vincent Ségal by chance, and the two began jamming together, uncertain of what kind of music might result. As a former member of the French National Orchestra, Ségal's Western classical training does not prevent him from exploring a wide variety of extended techniques, rendering his cello a flexible partner to Sissoko's kora. A childhood spent in the Pigalle district of Paris surrounded by immigrant communities exposed Ségal to African music from an early age. As such, he possesses a natural sensitivity to Sissoko's West-African style. The concert shows a brilliant interplay between the two musicians and combines the several worlds of jazz, Malian and classical music.

programme.title: Ella Fitzgerald - Antibes Jazz Festival, Jazz
programme.desc: The 1964 edition of the Antibes Jazz Festival in Juan-les-Pins saw the return of the First Lady of Song, Ella Fitzgerald. Together with Roy Eldridge on trumpet, Tommy Flanagan on piano, Bill Yancey on double bass, and Gus Johnson on drums, the tireless singer performed such classics from the Great American songbook such as 'Them There Eyes', 'The Lady Is a Tramp', 'Summertime', 'I'm Putting all My Eggs in One Basket', 'St. Louis Blues', and 'Perdido', and a few novelties, such as Steve Allen and Ray Brown's 'Cutie Pants'. It is no surprise this legendary concert from Juan-les-Pins was released on LP!

programme.title: Guitarlegend Wes Montgomery in The Netherlands, Modern
programme.desc: Wes Montgomery: Live in '65 shines a light on one of the most unique and influential guitarists in music history. These beautifully filmed programs from the spring of 1965 feature Wes, in intimate studio settings, leading three different lineups through some of his best-known tunes, including Four On Six, Jingles, and West Coast Blues. This rare footage, featuring rehearsals, between-song banter, and closeup camera angles, illuminates Wes's extraordinary musical vocabulary and unconventional picking technique.

programme.title: Tribute to Django Reinhardt: Rosenberg meets Beets, Fusion
programme.desc: World-class Dutch jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, Toots Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson, and John Clayton. His mother a music teacher and his father an Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey enthusiast, Beets was surrounded by music from an early age. And though music was in their blood, neither parent associated the word musician with a career. In this broadcast, Peter Beets teams up with gipsy jazz heros Stochelo Rosenberg, Martin Limberger and Frans van Geest. The strength and precision of Van Geests' rhythms and tempo, and the ease with which Stochelo's lead guitar soars above them, make this band a cohesive collective - unique in their renditions of standards, Django's classic compositions, and original tunes composed by Stochelo himself.

programme.title: Jazz à Vienne, Modern
programme.desc: Jazz à Vienne is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981, it has attracted a mix of jazz legends and exciting newcomers, with many of them playing return engagements. Each year welcomes outstanding international stars to the historical Le Théâtre Antique to impress and inspire their audiences. In 2019, French guitarist Paul Jarret performed with renowned New York drummer Jim Black at Jazz à Vienne. Together they present ‘Ghost Songs’, a hybrid of rock and jazz. They are joined by saxophonist Julien Pontvianne and pianist Jozef Dumoulin.

programme.title: Freddie Hubbard Quintet in Brussels, 1980, Modern
programme.desc: By the time this set was recorded at Brussels Jazz Club in the summer of 1980, trumpeter Freddie Hubbard had already built an impressive resume. During the 1960s he became a leading voice in the hard bop movement while not shying away from avant-garde sessions with the likes of John Coltrane and Eric Dolphy. In the 1970s, Hubbard expanded his palette by recording in more diverse settings that included electric instruments and orchestral arrangements. On this club date, Hubbard showcases all of the experience he had accumulated up to this point. The working group consists includes David Schnitter on tenor saxophone, Billy Childs on keyboards, Larry Klein on bass, and Sinclair Lott on drums. Watch as the quintet deftly switches between acoustic and electric instruments and Hubbard entertains the crowd with his onstage antics.

programme.title: Dee Dee Bridgewater: Motherland, Jazz
programme.desc: Singer Dee Dee Bridgewater walks in with considerable credentials, but this documentary related to her album ‘Red Earth’ trumps them all: Red Earth is a Malian journey that merges and melts all borders. While world-beat listeners will recognize the grooves, this is Bridgewater's first time bringing her own experiences as an African-American woman back to the motherland. It results in a fusion of feeling, visions, and music.

programme.title: STUFF. live at BIRD Rotterdam, Urban
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s BIRD is a club, café, and restaurant with a live music program that's deeply rooted in jazz, soul, funk, hip-hop, and electronic. Its name BIRD refers to the nickname of legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker. BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, fine wines, no-nonsense beers, and an all-round metropolitan rawness. Since 2014, this urban jazz club and DJAZZ.tv have been collaborating for a series of music programs: BIRD.tv, allowing you to experience the best BIRD concerts and interviews as from a first-row seat! Discover an irresistible live act; STUFF is full of unflagging energy. The Belgian band was founded in 2012 when drummer Lander Gyselinck was asked to play live music between DJ sets at a local bar. He gathered a bunch of friends, who also were musicians. The band could be considered an avant-garde jazz band who play a mix of funk, hip-hop, and electro. Andrew Claes (saxophone), Dries Laheye (bass guitar), Lander Gyselinck (drums), Mixmonster Menno (samples), and Joris Caluwaerts (keyboards) share an exceptional connection in music. They take over every stage and melt the hearts of music lovers.

programme.title: Anne Chris: Just Kissed The Sun, Modern
programme.desc: What happens when two musicians are "trapped" on a cruise ship for a week? Naturally, a new album sees the light of day - at least that’s what happened when Anne Chris and pianist Daan Herweg found themselves on a journey by ship together. After a week of providing their fellow passengers with musical entertainment, the two headed to the studio and within a year, Anne Chris’s new album Just Kissed the Sun saw its release. The Dutch singer presents her third album at the North Sea Jazz Club, accompanied by guest artist Bas van der Wal on guitar. Next to the sun, the sound of Robert Glasper, Gretchen Parlato, John Mayer, Esperanza Spalding, Jill Scott and Michael Jackson also seem to have inspired this joyful record.

programme.title: Dragon, Concert
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music - not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1987, American pianist Armando Anthony "Chick" Corea was one of the artists appearing here. Together with Frank Gambale on guitar, Eric Marienthal on saxophone, John Patitucci on bass and Dave Weckl on drums, Corea performed jazz fusion with his Elektric Band - a jazz subgenre inspired by the rock music and electronic instruments of the day. The band was nominated for two Grammy Awards.

programme.title: Musical Genocide, Concert
programme.desc: Unlike many of his fellow jazz cats, vocalist Gregory Porter transcends the jazz bubble. After sustaining a shoulder injury, this former American football player turned to jazz singing. He was discovered in a Californian jazz club by pianist, saxophonist and composer Kamau Kenyatta. Porter lent his vocal skills to gospel choirs across the country and a string of successful musicals before turning his talent to his own compositions. His rise since then has been meteoric. Porter’s magnificent, burnished baritone can sink into a lyric with luxurious ease, the melody gently sculpted into new shapes at every turn, with the rhythm tugging subtly back and forth across the bar line. This live performance at the Olympia showcases this man's worth, and is a truly amazing experience!

programme.title: Seine Sessions: Free & Afro Jazz, World
programme.desc: The term "jam-session" was born in the 1920s, when black and white musicians gathered in smoke-filled bars after their respective concerts to enjoy the kind of jazz they could not play in traditional sets. Bing Crosby was a regular at these sessions, and had fun marking the first and third beats of musical phrases by clapping hands, which the musicians call "jammin 'the beat". Today, the Seine Sessions revive the happy years of "jam sessions", while the cream of jazz, blues, gipsy and funk Parisian scenes occurs on the boards of the legendary restaurant and jazz club Le Réservoir. Entitled "Free & Afro Jazz," this episode hosted by Eddy King features unique performances by artists playing together for the first time, and interviews with Fantazio, Eddy Lopez, Banoit Savard, and many others.

programme.title: Tivoli Utrecht: Sven Hammond Soul, Soul
programme.desc: Although its music might sound like the sound track of any 1970s American car chase movie, the band Sven Hammond Soul is from the Netherlands. This steaming soul machine is headed by Sven Figee, who prefers to attack rather than play his Hammond organ. In April 2012, the band was augmented with vocalist Jenny Lane. Today’s recordings were made at a steaming live performance at Utrecht’s Tivoli in 2012.

programme.desc: Classical

programme.title: Festival Vue sur la Relève: SHPIK, Free
programme.desc: Montreal's very own jazz group SHPIK offers a bold and impressionistic music, drawing its inspirations from jazz, nature, and film. Evoking the great outdoors, self-discovery, and navigating between the immense and the infinitely small, this first album offers an intricate musical journey that is both energetic and reflective. Consisting of pianist and composer Arnaud Spick-Saucier, bassist Etienne Dextraze, drummer Philippe Lussier-Baillargeon, and saxophonist/flutist Alex Dodier, SHPIK has performed at famous jazz events, including the Montreal International Jazz Festival. Do yourself a favour by not missing this extraordinary breath of fresh air.

programme.title: Al Di Meola - Jazzwoche Burghausen, Jazz
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city. One of the artists performing here in 2019 is Al Di Meola. This pioneering guitarist blends world music, rock and jazz. His ongoing fascination for complex rhythmic syncopation, combined with provocative lyrical melodies and sophisticated harmony, has been at the heart of his music throughout a celebrated career. The Grammy Award-winner has achieved international fame both as a solo artist and due to his collaborations with the world's biggest artists.

programme.title: TorTube: Eric Vloeimans & Florian Weber, Modern
programme.desc: Jazz fans in television land have come to the right place for their dose of first-rate world jazz: TorTube! Jazz club De Tor in Enschede is one of Europe’s most authentic jazz venues, with an absolutely unique ambiance. Some of the best musicians from Holland and the rest of the world find their way to De Tor to perform for an appreciative audience of jazz fans. In this broadcast of TorTube, the great trumpeter Eric Vloeimans and his associate, pianist Florian Weber, perform a set named A good conversation (‘Een goed gesprek’). Great music and a perfect ambiance prove an irresistible combination!

programme.desc: Tristan se ponovno privikava na život u Skeldaleu, ali Carmody mu je uzeo krevet - i brata! Gđa Hall smišlja kako zbližiti dečke i šalje ih u kuriju Pumphreyevih nakon alarmantne dojave o odbjegloj životinji od ravnateljice vojne bolnice za oporavak. U međuvremenu, James se nada da će umiriti zabrinutog Sida Crabtreeja kada ga pozovu da liječi bolesnu kravu. Tristan u kuriji naleti na gđu Pumphrey kojoj je teško dijeliti svoj dom, a Tristan misli da se može poistovjetiti. James se trudi liječiti Crabtreejevu kravu i naježi se kad poštar predloži tradicionalnu domaću metodu koju James ne smatra djelotvornom. Zbog usputne primjedbe Sida Crabtreeja James se bori s nekim davno zakopanim osjećajima, a Helen je zabrinuta za njega. James otkriva Helen nešto što je dugo skrivao. Tristanovo i Carmodyjevo neslaganje dolazi do vrhunca i napokon uspijevaju naći zajednički jezik.

programme.title: Raj za dame, serija
programme.desc: Talijanska televizijska serija nastala prema romanu Emilea Zole 'Au Bonheur des dames' iz 1883., no radnja je premještena u Milano, 1956. godine. Glavni lik je Teresa, mlada žena koja ostavi Salva, zaručnika kojeg joj je otac odabrao jer je gradonačelnikov sin, i sa Sicilije odlazi u Milano. Teresa se nada da će se ondje zaposliti u stričevoj trgovini. No kad stigne u Milano, dozna da joj je stric na rubu bankrota i da je optužen za palež kombija ugledne robne kuće Raj za dame zbog koje gubi posao. Vlasnik robne kuće je Pietro Mori, mladi poduzetnik upitne prošlosti, koji je nakon putovanja u SAD u poslijeratno doba uspio otvoriti elegantnu i modernu robnu kuću. Teresa se prijavi na natječaj za prodavačicu u robnoj kući. Nakon niza peripetija uspije se zaposliti i pokaže da je ambiciozna i poduzetna djevojka i ubrzo stekne povjerenje kolega. Djevojka se na kraju ludo zaljubi u Pietra Morija, no mora se vratiti na Siciliju jer je njezin otac obećao gradonačelniku Castelbuona da će se Teresa udati za njegovog sina Salva.

programme.title: Bunt: Bend "Okot"
programme.desc: Ovo izdanje emisije Bunt posvetili smo još jednom bendu koji je bio zapažen na prethodnom, 9. Bunt rok festivalu. Niški sastav "Okot" osvojio je vicešampionsku poziciju i privukao pažnju, autentičnim zvukom i snažnim scenskim nastupom. Pesma "Inat", za koju je urađen i video spot, ovom muzičkom sastavu donela je festivalsku nagradu i epitet jednog od najupečatljivijih sastava Bunt rok festivala 2025. Branka Glavonjić je razgovarala sa frontmenom grupe - Mitrom Zorićem, koji je otkrio detalje u vezi sa nastankom pesama, muzičkim uticajima ali i specifičnom pristupu koji bend "Okot" neguje.

programme.title: Savremeni svetski pisci: Andrej Makin
programme.desc: Romaneskna životna putanja francusko-ruskog pisca Andreja Makina dala je posebnu notu njegovoj poetici. Rođen 1957. u Krasnojarsku u Sibiru, odrasta u sovjetskom režimu, u Moskvi završava Filološki fakultet, a sa 30 godina napušta Rusiju i dolazi u Pariz, gde traži politički azil. Sledi vreme lutanja, nemaštine i bezuspešnog obijanja pragova izdavača. Kada 1995. dobija Gonkurovu nagradu za roman Francusko zaveštanje, Andrej Makin preko noći postaje zvezda francuske književne scene.

Dobar dan BIH
programme.desc: Cilj emisije "Dobar dan BiH", koju radnim danima gledate na Hayat TV, prije svega jeste potaknuti pozitivne promjene u društvu, kod pojedinaca, ali i sistemske promjene. Ukazujemo na probleme, ne samo kako bismo informisali o njima, nego kako bismo podstakli razmišljanje i u konačnici ponudili rješenja. Radimo to dajući prostor ljudima koji su stručni za uske oblasti i koji su pozvani da savjetuju, kako vlast, tako i građane. Uvijek ističemo pozitivne priče i tragamo za njima kako bismo bili podrška onima koji su uspješni, ali i motiv drugima da pokušaju uspjeti. U našoj emisiji, pored poznatih lica iz svijeta politike, ekonomije, sporta, kulture, iz naše zemlje i svijeta, prostor nerijetko imaju medijski nepromovisane osobe, koje svojim "ljudskim" pričama i iskustvima obogaćuju sadržaj i daju vlastiti osvrt na ono što je njihov uspjeh ili problem.

programme.title: Planina ljubavi, serija
programme.desc: 123. epizoda - Vejsel i Taner dolaze u zatvor po Ramazana kojem je srce slomljeno Asumaninom odlukom. Asuman govori ocu da je povrijedila Ramazana izabravši da se vrati u njegovu kuću, a on joj saopćava da njihova porodica odlazi iz grada. Ramazan je odlučan da ode iz Gedelija kako više nikome ne bi stvarao nevolje. Vejsel i Džemile saznaju iznenađujuće novosti na ultrazvučnom pregledu.

programme.title: Rumi, serija
programme.desc: 15. epizoda - Sultan, vođen ponosom i hrabrošću, šalje dvadeset hiljada vojnika u susret Bajdžu Nojanu, odlučan da pokaže da se ne plaši neprijatelja. Magla prekriva bojno polje i briše tragove, ostavljajući vojsku samu u neizvjesnosti. U isto vrijeme, iza zatvorenih vrata kuje se zavjera, a Idrisov ubica ima samo nekoliko dana da se približi Mevlani i ispuni smrtonosni plan. Dok Mevlana govori o borbi protiv vlastitog ega, zlo mu se tiho približava iz sjenke.

programme.title: Moje ime je Farah, serija
programme.desc: 24. epizoda - Ali Galip govori Farah da će imati priliku biti doktorica kada dobije državljanstvo. Bade je ljuta na Veru jer želi pomoći Farah iako je ranila njenog brata. Mehmet upozorava Ali Galipa da drži svog sina pod kontrolom i da ne prilazi više Gonul. Farah konačno govori Tahiru šta joj se dogodilo u Iranu i zašto je pobjegla. Tahir govori Farah da će pristati biti Kerimšahov otac. Farah i Mehmet pokušavaju pomoći Gonul da se oraspoloži.

programme.title: Vjetrovi ljubavi, serija
programme.desc: 115. epizoda - Guldže saopćava Jusufu da želi razvod jer se ne mogu više pretvarati da su u braku. Jusuf se dvoumi da joj otvoreno prizna svoju ljubav. Zejnep govori Tulaj i Merve da napuštaju imanje i sele se u Ankaru. Zejnep iste vijesti saopćava i Zumrut. Dok razgovaraju, Feriha pokazuje Hakanu naušnicu svoje majke, a Hakan se sjeća da je istu vidio kod Guldže. Saznajemo da je školarinu za Merve tajno platio Džemil. Halil je tužan što Zejnep odlazi, a isto se osjeća i Eren zbog Selme. Halil i Zejnep razgovaraju o snazi ljubavi između njenog djeda i Zumrut.

programme.title: Mehmed: Osvajač svijeta, serija
programme.desc: 207. epizoda - Nakon pljačke crkve, kraljica Katarina naređuje da se opet prikupi porez od bogumila kako bi se nadoknadila nastala šteta. Katarina i Vlad sklapaju sporazum o saradnji. Do Mehmeda stiže vijest o Vladovom bjekstvu iz Tokata. Šehabetin-paša dolazi kao izaslanik kod bosanskog kralja Stjepana Tomaševića.

programme.title: Okovana ljubav, serija
programme.desc: 19. epizoda - Na proslavi na koju su pozvane i porodica Bičakči i porodica Karlidža razmjenjuju se čestitke i pokloni, a Ishak Ali i Dženap-aga pokušavaju nadmašiti jedan drugog luksuzom, dok se među njima jasno osjeća rivalstvo. Ajča posjećuje Ješil i djecu i saznaje da bi Džemile uskoro mogla izaći iz zatvora. Dok su porodice zauzete nadmetanjem na proslavi, na imanju nepoznati muškarac provodi Unalov tajni plan o Ješilinoj otmici. Tokom slavlja izbija napetost i podsmijeh između porodica, pogotovo u trenutku kada se Jasin zaštitnički postavi prema Menevše pred Tufanom, koji ga potom provocira spominjanjem dopinga.

programme.title: Mehmed: Osvajač svijeta, serija
programme.desc: 208. epizoda - Sulejman donosi Vladove pozdrave njegovom bratu Raduu. Šehabetin-pašu mučki ubijaju na dvoru kralja Stjepana. Zaganos i Mehmed tuguju za Šehabetinom. Bali-beg priča Kurtču Doanu ono što zna o Šehabetinovoj smrti: da su ga ubili bogumili. Zaganos se oprašta od svog najboljeg prijatelja. U Kneževinu Vlašku stiže Raduova i Vladova majka.

programme.title: Vjetrovi ljubavi, serija
programme.desc: 116. epizoda - Zejnep i Halil prebiraju po Zumrutinim stvarima i zajedno čitaju pismo koje je Zejnepin djed pisao Zumrut. Asu i Džanan likuju zbog izbacivanja Aslanlija s imanja. Guldže se sprema da ode, ali Jusuf ne želi da se razvede od nje. Zejnepin poslovni angažman u Ankari propada uz Halilovo posredovanje, ali ona ima rezervnu opciju. Halil govori Zejnep da ostanu u vili dok se ne snađu, a potom traži od Erena da provjeri firmu u kojoj će Zejnep raditi.

programme.title: Zarobljena, serija
programme.desc: 689. epizoda - Orhun i Hira se vraćaju iz bolnice kući i saopćavaju Afife i Sahri radosne vijesti o Hirinoj trudnoći. Ni nakon objave o trudnoći Ejlul ne odustaje od pokušaja da ostane nasamo s Orhunom. Planove joj kvari Behije koja joj zadaje nove poslove u kući. programme.title: Okovana ljubav, serija
programme.desc: 19. epizoda - Na proslavi na koju su pozvane i porodica Bičakči i porodica Karlidža razmjenjuju se čestitke i pokloni, a Ishak Ali i Dženap-aga pokušavaju nadmašiti jedan drugog luksuzom, dok se među njima jasno osjeća rivalstvo. Ajča posjećuje Ješil i djecu i saznaje da bi Džemile uskoro mogla izaći iz zatvora. Dok su porodice zauzete nadmetanjem na proslavi, na imanju nepoznati muškarac provodi Unalov tajni plan o Ješilinoj otmici. Tokom slavlja izbija napetost i podsmijeh između porodica, pogotovo u trenutku kada se Jasin zaštitnički postavi prema Menevše pred Tufanom, koji ga potom provocira spominjanjem dopinga.

programme.desc: U Jagodini od 1999. godine živi više od četiri i po hiljade Srba raseljenih sa Kosova i Metohije, ali je taj broj znatno veći. Doseljavanje u Jagodinu iz Peći, Gnjilana i drugih sredina počelo je ranijih decenija, kaže dr Miodrag Jarkin, predsednik Skupštine grada Jagodine. Srbi na KiM su trpeli pritisak i nasilje od stanovnika Albanije koji su decenijama dolazili u našu zemlju zbog privilegija koje su dobijali.

programme.title: VIJESTI
programme.desc: informativna emisija s prijevodom na znakovni jezik Vijesti Libertas televizije središnja su informativna emisija koja svakodnevno (od ponedjeljka do petka) donosi cjelovite, pravodobne i provjerene informacije. Kroz Vijesti progovaramo o problemima Dubrovnika i Dubrovačko-neretvanske županije. Građanima omogućujemo ostvarivanje prava na javno informiranje njegujući kulturnu raznolikost i dubrovačku baštinu uz poštivanje nacionalne, rasne, spolne i vjerske ravnopravnosti. Uz aktualne, a lokalne teme u Vijestima pratimo društveno-politički, kulturni i sportski život dubrovačke regije. U svakodnevnom smo kontaktu s gledateljima jer mišljenje građana nam je najvažnije.

programme.title: INFORMATIVNA PANORAMA, Grad kroz objektive kamera uživo
programme.desc: Uz biranu glazbu i pogled na najljepšu ulicu na svijetu (Stradun), gledatelji mogu promatrati Grad i s njegove najviše kote - tvrđave Imperijal na Srđu. Uz točno vrijeme i podatke o temperaturi zraka i mora, u dnu ekrana emitiramo niz informativnih sadržaja. Vijesti iz grada, zemlje i svijeta, novosti iz kulturnog i sportskog života te komunalne obavijesti osvježavaju se svakih pola sata, jednako kao i podaci o dnevnom rasporedu programa Libertas televizije.

Dežurni voditelj iz novinarske redakcije LTV-a, u formatu radijskog voditelja gledatelje informira o vijestima iz društvenog života, kulture i sporta te objavljuje korisne informacije komunalnih tvrtki, stanje u cestovnom, pomorskom i zračnom prometu. Redovite rubrike imaju dopisici iz doline Neretve, a povremene dubrovački iseljenici iz raznih krajeva svijeta.

programme.title: Miraculous: Pustolovine Bubamare i Crnog Mačka
programme.desc: Samo oni mogu spasiti Pariz od zlikovaca! Marinette Dupain-Cheng i Adrien Agreste naizgled su obični pariški srednjoškolci koji se ni po čemu ne razlikuju od svojih vršnjaka, no oboje kriju misterioznu tajnu - upravo su oni odabrani da svoj grad spase od zlikovaca. Zahvaljujući magičnom dragulju poznatom pod nazivom Miraculous, Marinette i Adrien transformiraju se u superjunake Bubamaru i Crnog Mačka te zajedno surađuju kako bi Pariz zaštitili od beskrupuloznog Hawka Motha koji na različite načine pokušava ukrasti Miraculous i oduzeti im moći, prijeteći kako će ih iskoristiti protiv njih te obične građane pretvoriti u negativce. No iako rade zajedno, ni Bubamara ni Crni Mačak ne znaju međusobne identitete. Mariette je potajno zaljubljena u Adriena, a on smatra kako je ona samo još jedna djevojka iz njegovog razreda. Miracolous: Pustolovine Bubamara i Crnog Mačka animirana je akcijska serija autora Jeremyja Zaga, nastala 2015. godine u produkciji francuskih studija Zagtoona i Method Animationa u suradnji s produkcijskim kućama De Agostini Editore u Italiji, Toei Animation u Japanu te SAMG Animation u Južnoj Koreji. Ideja o Bubamari i Crnom mačku nastala je na temelju američkih i francuskih stripova te japanske animacije, poput priče o Spider-Manu ili Mjesečevoj ratnici. Prva sezona krenula je s emitiranjem krajem 2015. godine, a ukupno je snimljeno 48 epizoda. O velikoj popularnosti serije svjedoči potvrđena treća sezona koja bi trebala biti premijerno prikazana 2019. godine te osvojena Teen Choice Awards nagrada za najbolju animiranu TV seriju iz 2018. godine.

programme.title: PJ Masks
programme.desc: Danju su sedmogodišnji Connor, Amaya i Greg obični školarci kao i sva druga djeca njihove dobi. No, kad se u gradu dogodi kakva nevolja, ovi posebno znatiželjni i pravdoljubivi mališani spremni su za svoju misiju. Kako bi ostali neopaženi, moraju čekati noć i da grad utone u san. U to vrijeme, umjesto da se kao i njihovi vršnjaci pripremaju za spavanje, naši junaci navlače svoje pidžame i čarobno se transformiraju u superjunake, PJ Masks. Oni postaju Catboy, superbrz i okretan dječak, Gekko, nevjerojatno snažan dječak koji može pomicati zidove te Owlette, djevojčica koja može letjeti i vidjeti na velike udaljenosti. Zajedno, ovo troje superdjece mogu svladati bilo koji problem - PJ Masks plove u noć kako bi spasili dan! Animirana serija "PJ Masks" nastala je prema maštovitom, originalnom i zapanjujućem serijalu bestseler knjiga Les Pyjamasques, francuskog autora Romualda Racioppoa. U njegovoj rodnoj Francuskoj, u kojoj je prva knjiga iz serijala objavljena 2008., do danas je objavljeno impresivnih 15 naslova, s planom izdavanja čak dva nova naslova svake godine pa s pravom možemo govoriti o izdavačkom pothvatu. "PJ Masks" prikazuje uzbudljive noćne pothvate troje mladih prijatelja koji se s mrakom, odnosno navlačenjem svojih pidžama i aktivacijom svojih životinjskih amajlija, transformiraju u svoja superjunačka alter ega, Catboya, Owlette i Gekka. Tako opremljeni, zajedno se upuštaju u akcijske pustolovine, rješavaju zagonetke i pritom usvajaju vrijedne životne pouke.

Istjerivači duhova, film
programme.desc: New York je u problemima: paranormalne aktivnosti raširile su se gradom poput kuge, povećavajući se iz dana u dan, a jedini ljudi koji su toga svjesni su tri izvanserijski inteligentna, no pomalo poremećena parapsihologa ostala bez stipendije za svoja znanstvena istraživanja. Izbačeni s akademije, započinju vlastiti posao. U ovom filmu nominiranom za Oscara za specijalne efekte, doktori Venkman (Bill Murray), Stanz (Dan Aykroyd) i Spengler (Harold Ramis) otvorili su dućan u staroj vatrogasnoj stanici i postali Istjerivači duhova, hvatajući dosadne duhove, prikaze i obične kućne sablasti za novac. No čak je i umijeće terminatora paranormalnih bića stavljeno na kušnju kad predivna Dana Barrett (Sigourney Weaver) i njen čudni susjed (Rick Moranis) postanu opsjednuti demonima koji žive u njihovoj kući. Ubrzo je svaki bauk u gradu pušten na slobodu i naši se heroji suočavaju s ultimativnim izazovom u demonskom hramu smještenom na vrh zgrade.

programme.title: Istjerivači duhova 2, film
programme.desc: Pet godina nakon bitke sa sljezovim kolačićem iz pakla, svijet se za istjerivače duhova pretvorio u neprivlačno mjesto. Nekolicina sudskih zabrana posve je ugušila njihovo djelovanje i učinila od njih zabavljače na dječjim rođendanima, ili voditelje emisija na kablovskoj televiziji. Dr. Venkman (Bill Murray) raskinuo je svoju vezu s dugonogom čelisticom, Danom (Sigourney Weaver), a ona se zaposlila kao restauratorica skupocjenih umjetnina. Kada se oko Danine osmomjesečne bebe, Oscara, započnu događati neobične stvari, zabrinuta majka shvaća kako je vrijeme za poziv u pomoć... Nastavak hita Ivana Reitmana snimljen je u istom kreativnom sastavu, i jedan je od rijetkih nastavaka koji kvalitativno ne gube ništa u odnosu na original. Upravo suprotno, ovdje je riječ o poboljšanoj verziji, još veselijoj i šašavijoj, okrenutoj više karakterima, a manje prema specijalnim efektima. Staro društvo ponovno je tu: ironični Bill Murray, Dan Aykroyd i Harold Ramis (ujedno i scenarist filma), te zabavni Rick Moranis. Tu je, naravno, i Sigourney Weaver, još jednom na meti zlih sila. Novi član ekipe, na strani negativaca, je uvijek raspoloženi Peter MacNIcol ("Ally McBeal"), kao misteriozni restaurator, Janosz Poha. Ivan Reitman filmsku je karijeru započeo kao producent ranih ostvarenja osebujnog redatelja Davida Cronenberga, no ubrzo je napravio veliki zaokret prema opuštenom žanru komedije, kojem je uglavnom ostao vjeran i danas. Neki od Reitmanovih najpopularnijih filmova su "Policajac iz vrtića" i "Blizanci" (oba sa Arnoldom Schwarzeneggerom) te romantična komedija "Šest dana, sedam noći" s Harrisonom Fordom i Anne Heche.
